::: {.callout-important title="Use your shop process"}
This is not a safety guide. Follow your teacher, training, and local rules.
:::

## Pick your plan

- **Level 3:** use the [current premade plan](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rdGC6nsCR6Z5DtoN071NhLQZxIc3XbFz0cQT_RCSFDs/edit?gid=452419533#gid=452419533).
- **Level 4:** use your approved CAD drawing.

## 1. Lay out

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A combination square marking a line on wood.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/combination-square-in-use.jpg)
![The measured plan for the two phone-holder parts.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/original-plan.png)
:::

Mark the edges, holes, and slots. Check every size.

## 2. Cut the parts

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A band saw cutting a wood shape.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/bandsaw-in-use.jpg)
![Two phone-holder parts cut from sheet wood.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/two-parts.jpg)
:::

Cut the outside shape with the chosen saw.

## 3. Drill the opening

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A drill press in a workshop.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/drill-press.jpg)
![A phone-holder plan with openings marked on the parts.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/original-plan.png)
:::

Drill at the marked point.

## 4. Cut the slots

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A coping saw on marked plywood.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/coping-saw.jpg)
![Two phone-holder parts with joining slots.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/two-parts.jpg)
:::

Cut the slots that join the parts.

## 5. Shape the edges

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A workshop belt and disc sander.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/belt-disc-sander.jpg)
![Kermit and Bob Ross phone holders with shaped edges.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/kermit-bob-ross.jpg)
:::

Shape the outside edges. Keep checking the drawing.

## 6. Finish sand

::: {.phone-step-visual}
![A random orbital sander.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/orbital-sander.jpg)
![A hand sanding a small piece of wood.](../../assets/phone-holder/tools/hand-sanding.jpg)
:::

Smooth the faces, edges, and curves.

## 7. Fit and finish

![A simple two-part holder supporting a phone.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/basic-phone-holder.jpg){.phone-final-photo}

Join the parts. Test the phone. Paint or finish the holder.

## Submit

[Submit the Onshape link, isometric image, and finished photo](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NgAOEpUvRkkanlb8MvY5porLpp18FNvFNbXxHZ6il-4/edit?tab=t.0).

The simple design comes from the [Westdale Cell Phone Holder Project](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1s9BFBX40vxdu2WpLCki3DKvmHzcZiEBl/view?usp=sharing). Use the current premade plan for current sizes and steps.
